engine.feedback.no_hint: No further hint is available: the procedure is complete.
engine.feedback.restarted: The experiment has been restarted with clean apparatus.
engine.feedback.submitted: The experiment has been submitted. Your report is ready.
engine.rejection.apparatus_known: That apparatus is not part of this experiment.
engine.rejection.below_mark: The liquid is already at or above the mark; water cannot be removed.
engine.rejection.flask_has_solute: There is no solute in the flask.
engine.rejection.flask_stoppered: Put the stopper on the flask first.
engine.rejection.flask_switch_allowed: The current flask already contains material; you cannot switch flasks now.
engine.rejection.funnel_on_flask: Place the funnel on the flask first.
engine.rejection.glassware_cleanable_and: That item cannot be cleaned now: it is not glassware that needs cleaning, or it still contains material.
engine.rejection.invalid_envelope: The action could not be processed.
engine.rejection.not_submitted: The experiment has already been submitted.
engine.rejection.safety_acknowledgement_: This action is unsafe. Confirm that you understand the safety warning before continuing.
engine.rejection.solid_on_watch_glass: There is no solid on the watch glass to transfer.
engine.rejection.stopper_state_changes: The stopper is already in that position.
engine.rejection.sufficient_solid: There is not that much solid on the watch glass.
engine.rejection.transfer_not_started: The solid has already been transferred.
engine.rejection.watch_glass_on_balance: Place the watch glass on the balance first.
engine.rejection.within_brim: The flask cannot hold that much liquid.
